atelier.meta.title: The atelier · forma
atelier.sub: One wedding, from the first inquiry to the last dance, exactly as forma carries it. Then the honest comparison, gaps included.
atelier.s1.p: A proposal presented, a contract signed by both, a deposit paid through Stripe. Nothing printed, nothing chased, nothing lost between three tools.
atelier.s2.p: Quotes, bookings and payments tracked to the line, per wedding and across the studio. The budget updates itself as the wedding takes shape.
atelier.s3.p: The budget, the decisions and the schedule, live in the couple's hands. Approvals happen in the portal instead of over Sunday messages.
atelier.s4.h2: RSVP, meal and seat, gathered once.
atelier.s4.p: Guests answer one elegant page. Meals, allergies and plus-ones collect themselves, and the seating chart draws from real answers, not a spreadsheet.
atelier.s5.h2: The run of show, in every hand.
atelier.s5.p: One timeline for the whole cast: every vendor gets their call time, every guest their schedule, your coordinator the door list. Written once, delivered everywhere.
atelier.s6.p: The whole studio at a glance, with the concierge keeping watch across all of it: what moved, what waits, what needs your eye this morning.
atelier.cmp.sub: Named, dated and defensible, cell by cell. Both are real tools, good at their jobs; the differences below are why forma exists.
atelier.cmp.r9: AI that works inside the weddings
atelier.cmp.fine: Compared August 2026, from public pages and documentation. Three rows are not ours yet, and we say so; they are why the roadmap looks the way it does.
atelier.close.h2: See it with your own weddings.
pricing.meta.title: Pricing · forma
pricing.meta.desc: In plain sight: $89 for the first account, $49 for each additional, everything included. Fourteen days free.
pricing.sub: Two numbers, everything included, the concierge included. The price follows the size of your studio.
pricing.p1.note: The studio's founding account. All of forma, the concierge included, and fifty weddings a year for the team.
pricing.p2.note: A teammate with their own login and exactly the permissions you grant. Each account adds twenty five weddings to the year. A studio of two pays $138.
pricing.p3.note: Only past the team's cap. Most studios never meet it; the ones that do are having a very good year.
pricing.capnote: The cap grows with the team: fifty weddings a year, plus twenty five for each additional account.
pricing.trial: Fourteen days free · No card to begin · Cancel any month
pricing.inc.h2: Every account includes all of it.
pricing.inc.i1: Fifty weddings a year, growing with the team
pricing.inc.i12: The AI concierge, on every account
pricing.q1: Do couples or guests ever pay?
pricing.a1: Never. Portals, RSVPs, websites and the registry are part of your plan. The studio pays once; the whole cast is invited.
pricing.a2: A person on your team with their own login: a coordinator, an assistant, a second planner. The first is $89, each after it is $49, and every account carries exactly the permissions you grant it.
pricing.q3: What happens past fifty weddings a year?
pricing.a3: The cap belongs to the team: fifty weddings a year, plus twenty five for each additional account. When a year outgrows it, $49 a month adds another fifty, and again from there.
pricing.a4: Yes. On every account, the planner's and every teammate's. It is not an add-on.
pricing.a5: Stripe, under the hood, in your name. Deposits and balances flow straight to your account, and processing costs are stated in plain sight before you send anything: Stripe's rate plus forma's one percent.
pricing.a6: Any month, in one click, and your data exports with you. We would rather earn the next month than lock the door.
about.meta.title: About · forma
about.h1: A wedding atelier, not another tool.
about.sub: forma is built by planners who plan weddings: multi city, multi event, in more than one language, with the day itself as the deadline. It exists because the whole wedding deserved one place, and the tools of the trade never gave it one.
about.env.h2: The star is older than the industry.
about.env.p: Our mark is the eight point star: two squares, one center, a form that has meant order and completeness since it was pressed into clay four thousand years ago. The oldest gardens of Persia were drawn the same way, four quarters gathered around a single point, and their name, pairi daeza, became the word paradise. That is the work, as we understand it: every part of the wedding, drawn to one center.
about.pr1.name: Composure
about.pr1.text: The planner with forma is composed, in command, and present for the craft and the couple. Everything we build serves that posture.
about.pr2.name: Honesty
about.pr2.text: Real numbers, dated claims, gaps admitted. Pricing in plain sight and a comparison that marks the rows we have not won yet.
about.pr3.name: Show, then say
about.pr3.text: The product is the proof. We would rather walk you through a seating chart than write an adjective about one.
about.pr4.name: Four languages, equals
about.pr4.text: English, Spanish, French and Italian, written as four originals. A wedding crosses borders; its software should cross them natively. Every wedding is kept in its own currency, every conversation in its own language.
about.close.h2: Plan the next one with us.
